Long, voluminous deep crimson hair with thick, flowing locks and straight bangs. Sharp, piercing almond-shaped eyes in a vibrant golden shade. Apparent age of a mature young adult with a confident gaze. Slender, elegant build. A stylized red and white traditional kimono with wide sleeves and a large decorative obi. Features a signature folding fan and ornate hairpins.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
